warnings: Axes: x = 1-3 (4.00 + 3.00); y = D, C, B, A printed top-to-bottom (4.00/2.00/3.50). Origin D1 — the same grid and origin as the corrected house 01 (บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 1); this is its earthquake-resistant edition.
Three interior beam lines are not dimensioned and were measured against the grid, all flagged: 1' (≈2.35, B1), 1'' (≈3.30, B2), D' (≈3.20, B2).
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget).
